intro.title: Other Rosaries Necklaces
intro.descriptionHtml: Collection of various rosaries and spiritual malas. Our conch shell malas are elegantly handcrafted. Conch shells stand for victory and are used as auspicious objects in ancient times. We have Putre Jeeva Mala made of seeds from the Putrajeeva tree having medicinal, mystic and Sattvic properties related to conceiving a child, Pancha Bhoot mala made of Sandalwood, Lotus seed, Rudraksha, Quartz crystal and Tulsi beads that wards off any negative energy and balance the panchtatvas in the body. We also have Christian rosaries made with natural Rudraksha beads. Chanting mantras or wearing spiritual malas help keep your mind calm and composed.
